rationale: Independent reading: held EO 11767 (39 FR 6603) designates the OAU under the IOIA, nothing else; held EO 13377 (70 FR 20263) sec. 3 'Revocation. Refutation attempts: verified quote; whole express revocation; no own term. D6: history holds only the revocation lead (two lines); corpus search finds no other held order naming EO 11767; no amendment before or revival after 2005 ignored. NO upheld.
